pages.text: The Charger provides a way to charge supported tools, and $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal)Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l).$(br2)Power can be provided via the top or bottom, via either AE2's $(l:items_blocks_machines/cables)cables$(/l), or other mod power cables. It can accept either AE2's power (AE) or Forge Energy (FE). Items can be inserted or removed from any side. Only the results can be

removed, so no need for filters to prevent removing certus crystals instead of charged certus. Can be rotated with a $(l:items_blocks_machines/wrench)Certus Quartz Wrench$(/l) in order to facilitate automation.$(br2)Can be used to create $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal_charged)Charged Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l) from $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal)Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l), and $(l:items_blocks_machines/meteorite_compass)Meteorite Compass$(/l) from $(item)Compass$().$(br2)To power it manually, place a $(l:items_blocks_machines/crank)Wooden Crank$(/l) on the top or bottom and right-click it until
the item is charged.$(br2)It also acts as the workstation for the $(l:items_blocks_machines/fluix_researcher)Fluix Researcher$(/l).
